headline: Verstappen finishes ninth on his GT return at Portimão
body: Verstappen took over the 2 Seas Motorsport Mercedes in 24th after a drivethrough penalty for team-mate Chris Lulham, and climbed to ninth. The car had qualified 15th at the Portimão GT World Challenge round.

headline: Red Bull uses an AI agent to recommend race strategy actions
body: The tool was built with title partner Oracle and began as a search of F1 regulations and past rulings. Red Bull's Jack Harington says it now recommends actions during grands prix, including advice to hand a place back to Norris at Monza in 2025 to avoid a penalty.
